Drawn in the bay's real orientation: FFC ribbon exits LEFT toward the ARM / DROK side, header on the RIGHT, breakout pin 1 at the BOTTOM.

As shipped the G469 has NO terminal silkscreen (the product photos lie). Apply THESE labels to the physical board.

G469 (seated on the header — either way round works, see the rule below)

breakout silk “1” = this end (bottom) — where the INA226 bring-up jumpers were

THE RULE: every screw terminal carries the header pin DIRECTLY BESIDE it (straight internal routing) — so this map is valid in BOTH 180° seatings.

Chain stays STRAIGHT — no elec-bay changes, FFC blue-stripe UP both ends, header pin n = Pi pin n. Zero new parts.

VERIFY before labelling or landing any wire: 1. bottom-left terminal → any GND = 3.3 V 2. BOTH bottom-right terminals (5V, 5V) → GND = 5 V

3. any GND terminal ↔ Pi ground = continuity (unpowered). Three readings anchor the whole map; then apply the labels and re-land the INA226 wires
